function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values, and `sample_seq` shows that some patients were re-tested (appearing in two rows). The data dictionary confirms that the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient.", "implication": "If I compute the mean across all rows, I will double-weight the 24 patients who were re-tested (since 48 duplicates = 24 patients with two rows). This violates the assumption of one patient per row. I must deduplicate on `patient_id`, keeping the row with the highest `sample_seq` for each patient, before computing the mean."}
function.name: note_finding
